**Audit Checklist — Aturseva Booking Token Screen (390px)**

1) **Pure English text** — **PASS**
   - All visible copy is English: "Booked", "Request sent", "Token being assigned", "Reception confirms your request…", "Track queue", "Share token", "Book again with this doctor". No Hinglish/Hindi found.

2) **Token/booking status as visual protagonist** — **PASS**
   - Hero card with status dot ("Request sent"), large bold "Token being assigned", explanatory subtext. Clearly the dominant element. Step tracker (Booked → Confirmed → Completed) reinforces it.

3) **Facts readable & aligned** — **PASS**
   - Doctor (Dr. Rajesh), Clinic, Date (Tomorrow), Time (09:15), Fee (₹300 · pay at clinic), City (Gandhinagar), Patient (E2E Tester), Reason — clean two-column label/value rows, right-aligned values, high contrast.

4) **Layout defects** — **FAIL**
   - "Cancel Booking" button at the bottom is **cut off / clipped** by the viewport — its top half is visible but the button is truncated, suggesting content overflows without adequate scroll space or bottom padding.

**Summary:** 3 PASS / 1 FAIL. Fix: reserve safe bottom padding or ensure the Cancel Booking CTA is fully scrollable into view.
